contract: Heartbeat versions 0 and 1 are accepted. The group version is the minimum across members. Version 2 and a non-range assignor are refused.
The range assignor gives each partition to one member. A leave moves those partitions to the remaining member without an overlap.
A member epoch older than the issued epoch is fenced. A skipped epoch is stale. The next heartbeat must present the epoch returned with the new assignment.
Reopen restores the assignment. An older coordinator epoch cannot heartbeat. A static instance replacement removes the previous member id.
limits: This is not the ConsumerGroupHeartbeat or ConsumerGroupDescribe RPC and it is not pinned to Apache response bytes.
The only server assignor is range. Uniform and sticky assignors are refused.
The journal format is the local PLCNS001 snapshot.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
